shots.text: Sunscar Canyon is red rock. The Stoneborn live in cities carved into its walls. Its Warden, Orrok, sleeps in the mountain at its head, under Grundhallow.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Red rock canyon by torchlight, cliff cities in terraces, giant stone faces of old kings.

shots.text: Orrok had gone mad, and the canyon could not keep out the storm. Lightning in armour walked down the walls. Over it, on a bird of black cloud, rode the Herald Vholt Stormcrown: a Galeborn warchief, and Kaela's old teacher.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Storm spirits in armour pouring down the walls. Above them, on a thunderbird of black cloud, an old warchief with a crown of lightning: Vholt.

shots.text: He taught me to ride. He taught me never to turn my back on a fight. If I have to kill him, I'll do it facing him.
shots.speaker: kaela
shots.art_note: Kaela on Thunderclap at the canyon rim, watching the black bird circle.
